alt: The Grokipedia homepage interface — a Wikipedia-style AI-generated encyclopedia launched by Elon Musk's xAI in 2025 — as it appeared before its April 2026 editorial freeze
story: xAI launched Grokipedia in October 2025 as an AI-powered Wikipedia rival that grew to 6 million articles; it stopped updating entirely on April 24, 2026, leaving 13,002 user edits stuck 'in review' for three months — while Musk never mentioned it after February and 6.7 million monthly visitors kept reading its frozen, unmoderated content without any warning.
why_funny: The AI encyclopedia that promised to never go out of date became more out of date than the Encyclopaedia Britannica volumes gathering dust in your parents' garage — and it didn't even tell anyone.
